text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not too shabby, but you could use some
practice
calculating this stuff on the fly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So what're you gonna do with the loot?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Not even a little bit. ...But on the
other
hand, we've gotta do something.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I bet there's someone at the academy
who'd be
interested. I'll check when we
get back.
